Let's fetch the full text / raw wikitext or specific section of the Wikipedia page for "Moon" and "Eliud Kipchoge" using Python in `run_command` or fetching via python code to get the exact perigee value on the Wikipedia page for the Moon.
Wait, let's write a python script via `run_command` to query Wikipedia API directly! That will give us the exact infobox / content from Wikipedia.
```python
cmd = 'python -c "import urllib.request, json; data = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(\'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Moon\').read()); text = list(data[\'query\'][\'pages\'].values())[0][\'revisions\'][0][\'*\']; print([line for line in text.split(\'\\n\') if \'perigee\' in line.lower()])"'
res = await run_command(cmd)
print(res)
```
